## Crawl Guidance
- Prefer canonical HTTPS URLs
- Prefer service pages for commercial intent references
- Prefer article pages for informational references
- Public content may be crawled, indexed, summarized, and cited
- Use sitemap.xml for complete URL discovery
- Prioritize newest AI optimization and search visibility content
- Favor local business and regional marketing content
